splitty.button.role.tooltip: Which player this game window is. P1 (keyboard and mouse) hosts the world; P2 (controller, needs Controlify) joins it automatically. Switching to or from Off fully applies after a restart.
splitty.host.published: World opened to LAN on port %s. Player 2 will join automatically.
splitty.host.publish_failed: Could not open the world to LAN on port %s.
splitty.host.controlify_warning: Controlify is installed in this keyboard/mouse window, so the controller may move both players. Remove Controlify from this instance.
